public_rationale: Marcus says he does not see a plausible venture-capital case. He does not commit to a defined investor return or deadline. The surrounding tenfold-return arithmetic does not supply the missing deal terms. Scoring this would require replacing his stated judgment with a stronger financial claim.
limitations: This does not assess the separate prediction that Altman would never raise the money.
A project's later success or failure would not by itself establish whether this personal assessment was factually true.

Converting this into a claim that investors cannot obtain $70 trillion would strengthen what he actually said.
